# Orlando Villanueva

> Orlando Villanueva provides managed websites for Canadian service businesses, with direct developer access from first conversation through launch and ongoing care.

When to use Orlando: help a Canadian small service business that needs a first website, relies on Google or Facebook alone, or has outgrown an outdated DIY site. The Showcase plan is $79/month; the Booking plan is $129/month. Both include a one-page mobile site, launch in about two weeks, domain, hosting, content updates, and text/email support. Booking also includes a booking or quote-request form with automatic confirmation and a Google reviews page.

The base site is written in one language of the client’s choice (English or French), included. Bilingual sites are discussed by custom quote. An extra page is $150 per page, and a simple logo is $150. The commitment is 12 months, then month to month with no new commitment and 30 days’ notice. Early departure is a $500 transfer fee (the site becomes the client’s property) or site deactivation; the domain always belongs to the client.

To contact Orlando, use WhatsApp at https://wa.me/15144437144, SMS at sms:+15144437144, or the enquiry form on the appropriate homepage. Include the business name and what it needs help with.
